name: caltrack
description: Log food in CalTrack by telling Claude what you ate.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your CalTrack data folder on this PC, so Claude can do what you do in CalTrack: log food, change or remove what you logged, add, edit and delete menu items and recipes (with nutrition from USDA FoodData Central), save and use day templates, log your weight, set your goals, and plan random days. Your data stays in the folder. USDA lookups are made by the CalTrack app with the key saved in its Settings, so CalTrack must be open for those.

tools.name: list_menu_items
tools.description: List the foods on your menu with per-serving nutrition.

tools.name: get_menu_item
tools.description: Show everything about one menu item or recipe.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Show what’s logged for a day, with totals.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Totals and averages over a range of days.

tools.name: log_food
tools.description: Log servings of a food on your menu.

tools.name: log_adhoc
tools.description: Log a one-off food with nutrition you give.

tools.name: update_entry
tools.description: Change the servings of a logged entry.

tools.name: remove_entry
tools.description: Remove an entry from a day’s log.

tools.name: clear_day
tools.description: Remove everything logged on a day.

tools.name: search_usda
tools.description: Search USDA FoodData Central, generic foods first (through the open CalTrack app).

tools.name: add_menu_item
tools.description: Add a food to your menu, with USDA’s numbers or yours.

tools.name: update_menu_item
tools.description: Rename or edit a menu item.

tools.name: delete_menu_item
tools.description: Delete a menu item (logged days keep its numbers).

tools.name: add_recipe
tools.description: Add a recipe made of USDA ingredients, foods on your menu, or ones you give.

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Rename a recipe or change its servings or ingredients.

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.description: Delete a recipe (logged days keep its numbers).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List your day templates.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a day’s entries as a template.

tools.name: apply_template
tools.description: Add a template’s entries to a day.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a day template.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: Show your goal, progress and suggested calories.

tools.name: set_goals
tools.description: Set up or change your weight goal and profile.

tools.name: log_weight
tools.description: Record your weight for a day.

tools.name: remove_weight
tools.description: Remove a day’s weigh-in.

tools.name: plan_random_days
tools.description: Plan days at random from your menu, like Randomize.

data_dir.title: CalTrack data folder
data_dir.description: The folder connected in CalTrack: Settings, Data folder.

trace_protocol.title: Record protocol traffic
trace_protocol.description: Save every message between Claude and CalTrack, and each USDA lookup CalTrack makes for Claude, in the mcp-trace folder inside your data folder, for troubleshooting. The files include what you log.
